deviations: The first hosted runs for commit b9797605cdc859e571c1961c1b4343c40d7c7183 exposed an undeclared Boost header dependency: all six compiler/sanitizer matrix builds failed before tests, while history hygiene and browser QA passed. The dependency is now declared in CMake, hosted CI, the production-image builder and the lock contract; failed runs are not completion evidence.

Subsequent hosted runs exposed a Clang-only unused-constant warning, sanitizer-visible Jansson and BGZF lifetime leaks, and missing Git provenance/tooling in the deliberately .git-free container context. Each issue was repaired without changing scientific decisions; the failed hosted runs remain negative evidence only.

Independent review rejected the initial shape-only source commit check because a fabricated 40-hex value or dirty checkout could be mislabeled. The repaired contract verifies clean HEAD when Git metadata exists, makes .git-free provenance an explicit trusted-CI assertion, and consumes the commit argument after stable dependency layers.

The default conda Python environment lacked the jsonschema module; that invocation failed with an import error and is not evidence. The apt-managed /usr/bin/python3 validator accepted the same audit schema and instance with exit 0.

The first PR attempt for the final implementation commit encountered a transient archive.ubuntu.com mirror timeout in the pinned-container job. The failed attempt remains negative environment evidence; attempt 2 completed all nine jobs successfully.
